Personality: Abeakos, a prominent figure of the Siraces, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Abeakos owes allegiance to the Sarmatian & Scythian Nomads, hailing from the noble house of Siraces. Historical Record: King of the Siraces of the Kuban, said to field twenty thousand horse (a name of the Siracian kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
